How to read a file

You can use os.ReadFile:

data, err := os.ReadFile("config.json")
if err != nil {
  return err
}

A few things to note:

  • It reads the whole file into memory.
  • For large files, use a streaming reader instead.
    • bufio.Scanner is the usual choice.
  • See the package docs for details.

Note: os.ReadFile returns []byte, not a string. Convert it with string(data) if you need text.
